item.title: Relay 0.9.0
item.description: Relay 0.9.0: the welcome in three steps: «Prepara tu Mac» shows only what needs you, «Quién hace cada paso» chooses the profile, and «Prueba que todo funciona» tries your agents and your apps' verify with that profile in the repo you choose; quitting or closing stops a running rehearsal with everything it started

item.title: Relay 0.8.0
item.description: Relay 0.8.0: every phase of a profile has its owner row in «Agentes y modelos»: «Corregir» also covers the PR's comments and the conflicts, «Rama, PR y merge» the branch's name, and nothing runs with a model you did not choose; wflow v0.25.0 inside: verify on web with wflow's own Chrome for every agent, the rehearsal that tries verify in each app (wflow doctor --live --verify) and the verify login per repo in the Keychain

item.title: Relay 0.7.0
item.description: Relay 0.7.0: profiles of agents per card: save your own with the names you give them (the three of wflow's stay as the starting ones), pick one in «Empezar card» for each card, and every card says which one it runs with; wflow v0.24.0 inside

item.title: Relay 0.6.1
item.description: Relay 0.6.1: giving the OK to a high-risk card no longer leaves its sheet stuck at «Dando el OK…» until the PR opens; it closes as soon as wflow takes the OK

item.title: Relay 0.6.0
item.description: Relay 0.6.0: the QA stop opens at its try, full size inside the card, with the plan in one line and the OK one click away; Relay says when it could not read your shell and your ~/.zshrc variables do not reach the cards; wflow v0.23.0 inside

item.title: Relay 0.5.0
item.description: Relay 0.5.0: a step of the history opens inside the card with what it did, Relay updates itself with a click, Enviar comentarios and uninstalling from Settings, the team's «Empezar» page, and Relay launches wflow with your shell's whole environment; wflow v0.22.0 inside
